ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR42] Requires Up-Sell Detail on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for cross-sell/upsell deals. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
OR( AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) ),
ISBLANK(IM_Up_Sell_Detail__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Up-Sell Detail is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
